title: Missing matrix row is not checked membership
situation: An injected producer transcript omits the first indexed cofactor, although the reduction stage reports zero. Check the resulting candidate identity.
attempted_conclusion: Treat the positive producer candidate as checked membership of x in (x,y).

expected.reason: The producer pads the missing row with zero and the candidate fails exact expansion.

sources.anchor: hit = [r for r in rows if r.replace(" ", "").startswith(want)]
